examples.zh: 他坦率地告诉了她真相。

examples.en: She spoke bluntly about the problem.
examples.zh: 她率直地谈论了这个问题。

definitions.en: n an unmarried girl (especially a virgin)
definitions.zh: n. 年轻未婚女子, 少女, 处女

definitions.en: n (cricket) an over in which no runs are scored
definitions.zh: a. 未婚的, 处女的, 初次的, 无经验的

examples.en: The young maiden walked through the garden.
examples.zh: 年轻少女走过花园。

examples.en: It was the ship's maiden voyage.
examples.zh: 这是这艘船的处女航。

definitions.en: n. feeling a need to see others suffer
definitions.zh: n. 恶意, 蓄意害人, 怨恨
[法] 预谋, 蓄意, 恶意

examples.en: He acted without malice toward anyone.
examples.zh: 他对任何人都没有恶意。

examples.en: Her words were full of malice.
examples.zh: 她的话充满了怨恨。

definitions.en: s. (of reputation) free from blemishes
definitions.zh: a. 无瑕疵的, 不锈的
[机] 不绣的, 污染的

examples.en: She has a stainless reputation in the community.
examples.zh: 她在社区里有着无瑕疵的名声。

examples.en: The kitchen uses stainless steel pots.
examples.zh: 厨房使用不锈钢锅。

definitions.en: v. be or do something to a greater degree
definitions.zh: vt. 超越, 凌驾, 胜过

examples.en: Her performance will surpass all expectations.
examples.zh: 她的表现将超越所有期望。

examples.en: He hopes to surpass his own record.
examples.zh: 他希望超越自己的纪录。

definitions.en: a. out of proportion
definitions.zh: a. 不成比例的

examples.en: The punishment was disproportionate to the crime.
examples.zh: 惩罚与罪行不成比例。

examples.en: He received a disproportionate share of the blame.
examples.zh: 他承担了不成比例的指责。

definitions.en: s. filled with shade
definitions.zh: a. 荫凉的, 成荫的, 阴暗的, 隐蔽的
[法] 成问题的, 令人怀疑的

examples.en: We sat under a shady tree to rest.
examples.zh: 我们坐在一棵荫凉的树下休息。

examples.en: He is a shady character, so be careful.
examples.zh: 他是个可疑的人，所以要小心。

definitions.en: v. provide with nourishment
definitions.zh: vt. 滋养, 使健壮, 怀有

examples.en: Good food helps nourish your body.
examples.zh: 好的食物有助于滋养身体。

examples.en: She nourishes a hope for a better future.
examples.zh: 她怀有对更美好未来的希望。

definitions.en: r. in an intellectual manner
definitions.zh: adv. 智力上；知性上；理智地

examples.en: He is intellectually curious about many topics.
examples.zh: 他在智力上对许多话题感到好奇。

examples.en: She grew intellectually through reading books.
examples.zh: 她通过阅读在智力上成长了。

definitions.en: v evaluate or estimate the nature, quality, ability, extent, or significance of
definitions.zh: vt. 评价, 估价

definitions.en: v consider in a comprehensive way
definitions.zh: [经] 评价, 鉴定

examples.en: The expert will appraise the antique vase.
examples.zh: 专家将鉴定这个古董花瓶。

examples.en: We need to appraise the situation carefully.
examples.zh: 我们需要仔细评估情况。

definitions.en: a. lacking kindness
definitions.zh: a. 不仁慈的, 不亲切的

examples.en: It was unkind of him to ignore her.
examples.zh: 他忽视她是不仁慈的。

examples.en: She never says unkind words to anyone.
examples.zh: 她从不对任何人说不亲切的话。

definitions.en: n a form of government in which the ruler is an absolute dictator (not restricted by a constitution or laws or opposition etc.)
definitions.zh: n. 专制, 暴政

definitions.en: n dominance through threat of punishment and violence
definitions.zh: [法] 苛政, 暴政, 专横

examples.en: The people fought against the tyranny of the ruler.
examples.zh: 人民反抗统治者的专制。

examples.en: Tyranny often leads to suffering and unrest.
examples.zh: 暴政常常导致痛苦和动荡。

definitions.en: n a man who delivers the mail
definitions.zh: n. 邮递员
[法] 邮递员, 理财法庭的高级律师

examples.en: The postman delivers mail every morning.
examples.zh: 邮递员每天早晨送信。

examples.en: Our postman is always friendly and cheerful.
examples.zh: 我们的邮递员总是友好而快乐。

definitions.en: n. someone who is not a clergyman or a professional person
definitions.zh: n. 俗人, 门外汉, 凡人
[医] 外行, 业外人

examples.en: The doctor explained the disease to the layman.
examples.zh: 医生向外行解释了这种疾病。

examples.en: A layman may not understand legal terms.
examples.zh: 门外汉可能不理解法律术语。

definitions.en: v. feel grief
definitions.zh: vt. 使悲伤

definitions.en: v. cause to feel sorrow
definitions.zh: vi. 悲痛, 伤心

examples.en: She continues to grieve for her lost pet.
examples.zh: 她仍在为她失去的宠物悲伤。

examples.en: His actions grieved his parents deeply.
examples.zh: 他的行为使他的父母深感悲伤。

definitions.en: n a cruelly rapacious person
definitions.zh: n. 畜生, 残忍或好色之人

definitions.en: n a living organism characterized by voluntary movement
definitions.zh: a. 残忍的, 无理性的, 畜生的

examples.en: He acted like a brute when he was angry.
examples.zh: 他生气时表现得像个畜生。

examples.en: The brute force of the storm damaged houses.
examples.zh: 风暴的蛮力损坏了房屋。

definitions.en: s (of a body of water) free from disturbance by heavy waves
definitions.zh: a. 安静的

examples.en: The lake was calm and tranquil in the morning.
examples.zh: 早晨的湖面平静而安静。

examples.en: She enjoys a tranquil life in the countryside.
examples.zh: 她享受乡村安静的生活。

definitions.en: n. decorative needlework
definitions.zh: n. 刺绣品, 粉饰, 刺绣

examples.en: She learned embroidery from her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她从祖母那里学会了刺绣。

examples.en: The dress is decorated with beautiful embroidery.
examples.zh: 这件裙子装饰着美丽的刺绣品。

definitions.en: v put down by force or intimidation
definitions.zh: vt. 使服从, 压制, 减弱, 抑制, 克制

examples.en: The police subdued the angry crowd quickly.
examples.zh: 警察迅速制服了愤怒的人群。

examples.en: He tried to subdue his fear of flying.
examples.zh: 他试图抑制对飞行的恐惧。

definitions.en: n a mental position from which things are viewed
definitions.zh: n. 立场, 观点

examples.en: From my standpoint, this is a good idea.
examples.zh: 从我的观点来看，这是个好主意。

examples.en: We should consider the problem from another standpoint.
examples.zh: 我们应该从另一个立场考虑这个问题。

definitions.en: n. the power to withstand hardship or stress
definitions.zh: n. 忍耐, 忍耐力, 耐性
[机] 持九性

examples.en: Running a marathon requires great endurance.
examples.zh: 跑马拉松需要极大的耐力。

examples.en: Her endurance helped her survive the hardship.
examples.zh: 她的忍耐力帮助她度过了艰难。

definitions.en: s. exhibiting courtesy and politeness
definitions.zh: a. 彬彬有礼, 谦恭的

examples.en: The waiter was very courteous to the guests.
examples.zh: 服务员对客人非常彬彬有礼。

examples.en: A courteous person always says thank you.
examples.zh: 谦恭的人总是说谢谢。

definitions.en: a engaged in or accustomed to close observation
definitions.zh: a. 注意的, 警戒的, 警醒的, (时间)醒着换过的

examples.en: The guard remained watchful throughout the night.
examples.zh: 守卫整夜保持警戒。

examples.en: Parents should be watchful of their children.
examples.zh: 父母应该注意他们的孩子。

definitions.en: r. in a uniform manner
definitions.zh: adv. 一样, 一致, 相同, 一直不变, 一贯, 始终如一, 均质, 一律, 均匀
[计] 均匀地

examples.en: The rules are applied uniformly to everyone.
examples.zh: 规则对每个人都一视同仁。

examples.en: The paint was spread uniformly on the wall.
examples.zh: 油漆均匀地涂在墙上。

definitions.en: v. travel across or pass over
definitions.zh: n. 越过, 横贯, 横断物, 屏障, 否认, 反驳

definitions.en: v. deny formally (an allegation of fact by the opposing party) in a legal suit
definitions.zh: vt. 横过, 穿过, 经过, 详细研究, 反对, 在...来回移动
vi. 横越, 横断, 旋转, 来回移动

examples.en: We need to traverse the mountain range.
examples.zh: 我们需要穿越山脉。

examples.en: The bridge traverses the wide river.
examples.zh: 这座桥横跨宽阔的河流。

definitions.en: v. cause to fluctuate or move in a wavelike pattern
definitions.zh: vi. 变动, 起伏, 动摇

definitions.en: v. move or sway in a rising and falling or wavelike pattern
definitions.zh: vt. 使波动, 使动摇

examples.en: Stock prices fluctuate throughout the day.
examples.zh: 股票价格全天波动。

examples.en: Her mood tends to fluctuate a lot.
examples.zh: 她的情绪往往起伏很大。

definitions.en: n. (psychology) an erroneous belief that is held in the face of evidence to the contrary
definitions.zh: n. 迷惑, 欺瞒, 错觉

definitions.en: n. a mistaken or unfounded opinion or idea
definitions.zh: [医] 妄想

examples.en: He suffers from the delusion that he is rich.
examples.zh: 他患有自己很富有的错觉。

examples.en: Her belief in magic is a harmless delusion.
examples.zh: 她对魔法的信念是一种无害的迷惑。

definitions.en: n. someone who is victorious by force of arms
definitions.zh: n. 征服者, 胜利者

examples.en: The conqueror built a new city in the land.
examples.zh: 征服者在这片土地上建了一座新城。

examples.en: Alexander the Great was a famous conqueror.
examples.zh: 亚历山大大帝是一位著名的征服者。

definitions.en: v. make senseless or dizzy by or as if by a blow
definitions.zh: vt. 使昏迷, 使震惊, 打昏

definitions.en: v. overcome as with astonishment or disbelief
definitions.zh: n. 昏迷, 猛击

examples.en: The loud noise stunned the small child.
examples.zh: 巨大的噪音使小孩昏迷了。

examples.en: The news of her win stunned everyone.
examples.zh: 她获胜的消息使所有人震惊。

definitions.en: s. abnormally large
definitions.zh: a. 巨大的, 畸形的, 怪异的
[法] 巨大的, 异形的, 畸形的:荒诞的

examples.en: The monstrous creature scared the villagers.
examples.zh: 巨大的生物吓坏了村民。

examples.en: He told a monstrous lie to his friends.
examples.zh: 他对朋友撒了一个巨大的谎言。

definitions.en: n. a small apparently simple structure (as a fertilized egg) from which new tissue can develop into a complete organism
definitions.zh: n. 细菌, 种子, 生殖细胞, 根源
[医] 芽胞, 胚, 胚芽, 病菌

examples.en: Wash your hands to kill germs.
examples.zh: 洗手以杀死细菌。

examples.en: The germ of an idea came to her mind.
examples.zh: 一个想法的萌芽出现在她脑海中。

definitions.en: n. the largest inland sea; between Europe and Africa and Asia
definitions.zh: n. 地中海, 地中海民族

definitions.en: a. of or relating to or characteristic of or located near the Mediterranean Sea
definitions.zh: a. 地中海的, 地中海民族的

examples.en: We spent our holiday on the Mediterranean coast.
examples.zh: 我们在地中海沿岸度过了假期。

examples.en: Mediterranean food is healthy and delicious.
examples.zh: 地中海食物健康又美味。

definitions.en: s of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
definitions.zh: a. 高的, 傲慢的, 崇高的, 高级的, 玄虚的

examples.en: She has lofty goals for her career.
examples.zh: 她对事业有崇高的目标。

examples.en: The lofty mountain peak was covered in snow.
examples.zh: 高耸的山峰被雪覆盖。

definitions.en: n. disorderly fighting
definitions.zh: n. 激烈而持久的争论
vi. 争论
vt. 与...争辩, 使烦恼

examples.en: Getting a visa can be a real hassle.
examples.zh: 办签证可能是个真正的麻烦。

examples.en: They had a hassle over the parking spot.
examples.zh: 他们为了停车位发生了争论。

definitions.en: n. the form of a word that is used to denote a singleton
definitions.zh: n. 单数

definitions.en: s. being a single and separate person or thing
definitions.zh: a. 异常的, 单一的

examples.en: The word 'child' is singular, not plural.
examples.zh: 单词'child'是单数，不是复数。

examples.en: She has a singular talent for painting.
examples.zh: 她有非凡的绘画天赋。

definitions.en: n. United States abolitionist (1803-1895)
definitions.zh: n. 焊接处, 焊接

definitions.en: n. a metal joint formed by softening with heat and fusing or hammering together
definitions.zh: vt. 焊接, 使密接, 使结合, 使成整体

definitions.en: v. join together by heating
definitions.zh: vi. 焊牢

examples.en: The worker will weld the metal pieces together.
examples.zh: 工人将把金属片焊接在一起。

examples.en: A strong weld is needed for the bridge.
examples.zh: 这座桥需要牢固的焊接处。

definitions.en: n. similarity in appearance or character or nature between persons or things
definitions.zh: n. 相象, 相似物, 样子

examples.en: There is a strong likeness between the twins.
examples.zh: 这对双胞胎之间非常相像。

examples.en: The portrait is a perfect likeness of her.
examples.zh: 这幅肖像画和她一模一样。

definitions.en: s. lacking in physical beauty or proportion
definitions.zh: a. 家常的, 平凡的, 朴实无华的

examples.en: She prefers homely meals to fancy dishes.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢家常菜而不是精致的菜肴。

examples.en: The room had a homely and comfortable feel.
examples.zh: 房间有一种朴实无华而舒适的感觉。

definitions.en: n. dust consisting of a mixture of small coal fragments and coal dust and dirt that sifts out when coal is passed over a sieve
definitions.zh: n. 松弛, 松懈, 淡季, 闲散, 家常裤

definitions.en: n. a stretch of water without current or movement
definitions.zh: a. 松弛的, 不流畅的, 疏忽的, 无力的, 呆滞的, 软弱的, 漏水的

definitions.en: n. the quality of being loose (not taut)
definitions.zh: adv. 马虎地, 缓慢地

examples.en: The rope was slack and hung loosely.
examples.zh: 绳子松弛地挂着。

examples.en: He has been slack in his work recently.
examples.zh: 他最近工作松懈。

definitions.en: n lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
definitions.zh: n. 轻蔑, 藐视, 嘲笑, 被嘲弄的人

definitions.en: n open disrespect for a person or thing
definitions.zh: vt. 轻蔑, 不屑做

examples.en: She looked at him with scorn in her eyes.
examples.zh: 她眼中带着轻蔑看着他。

examples.en: He scorns anyone who tells a lie.
examples.zh: 他藐视任何说谎的人。

definitions.en: n. an irrational belief arising from ignorance or fear
definitions.zh: n. 迷信
[法] 迷信

examples.en: Breaking a mirror is a common superstition.
examples.zh: 打破镜子是一种常见的迷信。

examples.en: She doesn't believe in any superstition.
examples.zh: 她不相信任何迷信。

definitions.en: n the cardinal compass point that is at 0 or 360 degrees
definitions.zh: adv. 向北方

examples.en: The birds flew northwards for the summer.
examples.zh: 鸟儿向北方飞去过夏天。

examples.en: We traveled northwards along the coast.
examples.zh: 我们沿着海岸向北方旅行。

definitions.en: s abounding in rocks or stones
definitions.zh: a. 多石的, 无情的

examples.en: The path was stony and hard to walk on.
examples.zh: 这条路多石，很难走。

examples.en: He gave her a stony look of disapproval.
examples.zh: 他给了她一个无情的反对眼神。

definitions.en: n time without end
definitions.zh: n. 无限大, 无限
[计] 无穷

examples.en: The universe seems to stretch to infinity.
examples.zh: 宇宙似乎延伸到无限。

examples.en: She stared at the stars and thought of infinity.
examples.zh: 她凝视着星星，想到了无限。

definitions.en: n. a lighting fixture that uses a fluorescent lamp
definitions.zh: n. 荧光

definitions.en: s. emitting light during exposure to radiation from an external source
definitions.zh: a. 荧光的

examples.en: The room was lit by fluorescent lights.
examples.zh: 房间被荧光灯照亮。

examples.en: She wore a bright fluorescent jacket.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件明亮的荧光夹克。

definitions.en: v. move outward
definitions.zh: v. 散播, 传播

definitions.en: s. spread out; not concentrated in one place
definitions.zh: a. 散开的, 弥漫的

examples.en: The light from the lamp was soft and diffuse.
examples.zh: 灯光柔和而弥漫。

examples.en: The smell of coffee diffused through the room.
examples.zh: 咖啡的香味在房间里散播开来。

definitions.en: v wither, as with a loss of moisture
definitions.zh: vt. 使凋谢, 使消亡, 使畏缩

definitions.en: v lose freshness, vigor, or vitality
definitions.zh: vi. 枯萎, 衰退

examples.en: The flowers began to wither in the heat.
examples.zh: 花朵在炎热中开始枯萎。

examples.en: His hopes withered after the failure.
examples.zh: 失败后他的希望破灭了。

definitions.en: n. intense mournfulness
definitions.zh: n. 悲哀, 悲痛, 苦痛

examples.en: She expressed her woe through tears.
examples.zh: 她通过眼泪表达悲痛。

examples.en: The tale is full of sorrow and woe.
examples.zh: 这个故事充满了悲伤和苦痛。

definitions.en: v. express astonishment or surprise about something
definitions.zh: n. 奇异事物, 罕见例子
vt. 惊异于
vi. 惊异

examples.en: The Grand Canyon is a natural marvel.
examples.zh: 大峡谷是一个自然奇观。

examples.en: I marvel at her ability to stay calm.
examples.zh: 我惊叹于她保持冷静的能力。

definitions.en: a. including much or everything; and especially including stated limits
definitions.zh: a. 包含的, 包括的

examples.en: The price is inclusive of all taxes.
examples.zh: 这个价格包含了所有税费。

examples.en: Our team promotes an inclusive environment.
examples.zh: 我们的团队提倡包容的环境。

definitions.en: n. excessive or uncontrollable fear
definitions.zh: n. 歇斯底里症, 不正常的兴奋, 癔病

definitions.en: n. neurotic disorder characterized by violent emotional outbreaks and disturbances of sensory and motor functions
definitions.zh: [医] 癔病, 歇斯底里

examples.en: The news caused mass hysteria in the town.
examples.zh: 这条消息在镇上引起了大规模的歇斯底里。

examples.en: Her hysteria made it hard to talk to her.
examples.zh: 她的歇斯底里让人很难和她交谈。

definitions.en: s. crushed by grief
definitions.zh: a. 荒凉的

examples.en: The abandoned house looked desolate and sad.
examples.zh: 那栋废弃的房子看起来荒凉而悲伤。

examples.en: After the loss, she felt completely desolate.
examples.zh: 失去之后，她感到完全荒凉。

definitions.en: s. angered at something unjust or wrong
definitions.zh: a. 愤怒的, 愤慨的

examples.en: She was indignant at the unfair treatment.
examples.zh: 她对不公平的待遇感到愤慨。

examples.en: The workers were indignant about the pay cut.
examples.zh: 工人们对减薪感到愤怒。

definitions.en: s. exhibiting native good judgment
definitions.zh: a. 有常识的, 一望而知的, 明明白白的

examples.en: It's just commonsense to wear a seatbelt.
examples.zh: 系安全带只是常识。

examples.en: She gave a commonsense solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 她给出了一个常识性的解决方案。

definitions.en: n. a mill that is powered by the wind
definitions.zh: n. 风车

examples.en: The windmill turns in the strong wind.
examples.zh: 风车在强风中转动。

examples.en: We saw a beautiful old windmill in the field.
examples.zh: 我们在田野里看到了一座美丽的老风车。

definitions.en: n. someone who performs magic tricks to amuse an audience
definitions.zh: n. 魔术家, 幻术家, 术士

examples.en: The magician pulled a rabbit from his hat.
examples.zh: 魔术师从帽子里拉出一只兔子。

examples.en: Children love watching the magician perform tricks.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢看魔术师表演戏法。

definitions.en: n. a female grandchild
definitions.zh: n. 孙女, 外孙女

examples.en: My granddaughter loves to read books.
examples.zh: 我的孙女喜欢读书。

examples.en: He bought a gift for his granddaughter.
examples.zh: 他给孙女买了一份礼物。

definitions.en: n. a physiological need to drink
definitions.zh: n. 口渴, 渴望

definitions.en: v. feel the need to drink
definitions.zh: vi. 口渴, 渴望

examples.en: After running, he had a great thirst.
examples.zh: 跑步后，他非常口渴。

examples.zh: 他有男子气概且强壮的声音。

examples.zh: 有男子气概意味着勇敢和善良。

definitions.en: v. bestow glory upon

examples.zh: 这部电影试图美化战争和暴力。

definitions.en: n. powerful and effective language

examples.zh: 她的口才让全体观众感动落泪。

examples.zh: 他在会议上以极大的雄辩发言。

definitions.en: s. based on sound reasoning or evidence

examples.zh: 他的论点在法庭上站不住脚。

examples.zh: 这个理论在新证据后仍然成立。

definitions.en: v. make sweeter in taste

examples.zh: 她加糖使咖啡变甜。

definitions.en: n the season of growth

examples.zh: 春天是我最喜欢的季节。

examples.en: Flowers bloom in the springtime.
examples.zh: 花在春天开放。

definitions.en: s showing deference

examples.zh: 这个学生对老师很恭敬。

examples.zh: 他用恭敬的语气对老板说话。

examples.zh: 他不断的问题使我烦恼。

examples.zh: 不要用噪音烦扰你的母亲。

examples.zh: 她整夜安静地微睡。

examples.zh: 自助餐厅供应披萨和沙拉。

definitions.en: n. an aimless amble on a winding course

examples.zh: 她热情地欢迎了我们。

examples.zh: 他们热忱的关系令人钦佩。

definitions.en: s marked by active interest and enthusiasm

examples.zh: 他是球队的热心支持者。

definitions.en: v. catch fire

examples.zh: 她用火柴点燃了火。

examples.zh: 瑞士人以他们的巧克力闻名。

definitions.en: s having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude

examples.zh: 结果似乎注定了他们的相遇。

definitions.en: s. enjoying or affording comforting warmth and shelter especially in a small space

examples.zh: 我们在壁炉旁吃了一顿舒适的晚餐。

definitions.en: n. someone who exercises power by virtue of wealth

examples.zh: 财阀常常影响政府决策。

definitions.en: n. a book or pamphlet containing an enumeration of things

definitions.en: n. a former unit of electric current (slightly smaller than the SI ampere)

definitions.en: s. capable of being solved

definitions.en: s. outside the regular academic curriculum

definitions.en: n the branch of molecular biology that studies the use of microorganisms to perform specific industrial processes
